content:
emily-peopleops: Quick thread for managers who've asked about promotions affecting international employees + title vs comp questions. Drop Qs here.

trevor-engmgr: We have an IC in UK moving to lead a small cross-functional project. Do we do a local UK band adjustment or apply US band equivalents?

emily-peopleops: We use the local market band for payroll/legal, but map it to our internal band for leveling. So title/level can be L4 (internal) while comp aligns to UK band and local market comp. Include the comp mapping tab in the packet.

yasmin-ic: If level changes but comp doesn't (title bump only), do we still run it through calibration?

emily-peopleops: Yes. Any change to level or title goes through calibration. If comp is unchanged, still document scope + impact + manager rationale. We note "title-only" in packet.

diego-peopleops: For UK/EMEA promos, ensure tax/regulatory approvals: send the Workday change + local payroll ticket 10 business days before effective date.

comp-bot: Reminder: international comp conversions use the latest market index (region_index_2026_v2). See internal docs: https://confluence.redwood/people/intl-comp-mapping

trevor-engmgr: How do we handle probation/manager transitions when someone moves from IC->people manager during promo? Any special notice?

emily-peopleops: For IC->manager, add 90-day new manager check-in in the packet, include a leadership development plan and the manager training enrollment. This is required for all first-time people managers.

yasmin-ic: Do equity grants change when moving levels? I got an offer to move to manager but unclear on refresh timing.

emily-peopleops: Standard: if promo increases level by one band or more, include an equity refresh recommendation. Grant timing is quarterly; off-cycle grants can be requested with comp justification. Document requested grant size and rationale.

diego-peopleops: Budget note: off-cycle equity or >12% comp bumps need Finance waypoint; plan for 2-week delay.

trevor-engmgr: What about communications to team vs the individual?

emily-peopleops: Manager-led one-on-one with the individual first. Company-wide or team announcement after HR confirms payroll/title changes. We provide announcement template if you want.

yasmin-ic: If someone declines a promotion (wants to keep IC comp/role), any standard path?

emily-peopleops: Yes — they can decline. We document the offer and the employee's decision, note if they want a skills/mentorship plan instead. No automatic comp change if declined.

comp-bot: FYI: Next calibration export is 2026-04-05. Submit packets by 2026-04-01 to be included.

trevor-engmgr: Awesome, thanks. I'll start the packet and ping Diego for the payroll ticket.

emily-peopleops: Thanks — ping me the draft and we'll fast-track UK conversions.
